name: STA304H1 — Deductive Derivation (Observational Studies and Confounding)

steps.template_en: Correlation ≠ Causation. Observational studies only show ASSOCIATION. Confounder: variable associated with BOTH treatment and outcome. Simpson's paradox: trend reverses when grouping by confounder.
steps.template_zh: 相关≠因果。观测研究只展示关联。混杂：与处理和结果都相关的变量。Simpson悖论：按混杂分组时趋势反转。

steps.template_en: Example: Hospital A has lower survival rate than B (73% vs 79%). But within good-condition patients, A is better (93% vs 87%). Within poor-condition, A also better (73% vs 67%). A treats sicker patients → aggregation hides truth.
steps.template_zh: 例：A院生存率低于B(73% vs 79%)。但良好状态患者中A更好(93% vs 87%)。差状态中A也更好。A治疗更重病人→聚合隐藏真相。

steps.template_en: Methods to adjust for confounders: (1) Stratification. (2) Multivariable regression. (3) Propensity score matching — P(treatment|covariates). (4) Instrumental variables. (5) Difference-in-differences.
steps.template_zh: 调整混杂的方法：(1)分层。(2)多元回归。(3)倾向评分匹配。(4)工具变量。(5)双重差分。

steps.template_en: Propensity score: e(X)=P(T=1|X). Key property: treatment assignment is INDEPENDENT of potential outcomes conditional on e(X). Matching on PS creates balanced groups.
steps.template_zh: 倾向评分：e(X)=P(T=1|X)。关键：在e(X)条件下处理分配独立于潜在结果。PS匹配创建平衡组。

steps.template_en: Study: new drug vs placebo. Patients on drug are younger. Outcomes: drug group recovers faster. (1) Is age a confounder? (2) How would you adjust? (3) Compute propensity score. (4) Match or stratify by PS. (5) After adjustment, does effect remain?
steps.template_zh: 新药研究：用药组更年轻，恢复更快。(1)年龄是混杂吗？(2)如何调整？(3)计算倾向评分。(4)用PS匹配或分层。(5)调整后效应还在吗？

steps.template_en: 'Correlation does not imply causation' — the most important warning in statistics. But advanced methods (RCTs, IV, DiD, RDD) can identify causal effects. The GOLD STANDARD is the randomized controlled trial.
steps.template_zh: '相关不意味因果'——统计最重要警告。但高级方法(RCT、IV、DiD、RDD)可识别因果效应。金标准是随机对照试验。
